proof_body:
by
  intro G E _ _ _ _ _ μ _ _ _ _ φ r g x₀ _ hn hi hs hr hg
  refine MeasureTheory.convolution_tendsto_right (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hn) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hi) ?_ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => hg.aestronglyMeasurable) ((hg.tendsto x₀).comp Filter.tendsto_snd) tendsto_const_nhds
  rw [Filter.tendsto_smallSets_iff]
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hb⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp ht
  filter_upwards [hr.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ) hε)] with n hn'
  have hlt : r n < ε := by simpa [abs_lt, Real.dist_eq] using (abs_lt.mp (by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hn')).2
  exact (hs n).trans ((Metric.ball_subset_ball hlt.le).trans hb)
target_source: ∀ (G E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [FiniteDimensional ℝ G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (φ : ℕ → G → ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (g : G → E) (x₀ : G), (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (φ n)) → (∀ n x, 0 ≤ φ n x) → (∀ n, ∫ x, φ n x ∂μ = 1) → (∀ n, Function.support (φ n) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : G) (r n)) → Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Continuous g → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.convolution (φ n) g (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) μ x₀) Filter.atTop (nhds (g x₀))
